name: Umbral Wood (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a dark forest, where shadowed magic and vile druids are the norm.

Imperial Training: war razor

Overloaded Mark: While the mark is active, the target takes a penalty to saving throws against effects that cause the sickened or nauseated conditions or those that knock them prone or entangle equal to 1/3 your class level (minimum -1). Additionally, when the mark is expended, is sickened for 1 round if they are not already.

Imperial Origin Abilities
Vile Vine (Sp)

At 1st level, as a standard action you can launch a disgusting vine at a target within 30 feet. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to affect the target. On a hit, the target is sickened and must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier) or be knocked prone. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Whitewood Lash (Sp)

At 7th level, to channel the umbral wood through your hands as a standard action.

You must succeed on a melee touch attack to affect the target. On a hit, you deal 1d6 damage per 2 class levels you possess. Half of the damage is piercing damage, the other half is negative energy. If the target is under the effect of a light spell, or it holding an item with a light spell on it, you may dispel the effect as if you cast dispel magic using your class level as the caster level. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Umbral Awareness (Ex)

At 14th level, you gain darkvision out to an unlimited range and the see in darkness universal monster ability.
